workflow: A separate Goods Receipt Note can receive goods without an existing Purchase Order. Store Inventory > Restock alone does not satisfy this requirement.
optionalUserInputs: All other receipt details, including delivery-note/reference number, dates, notes, damage/rejection details and attachments, are optional.
minimumScenario: Receive one QA product from a QA supplier using only supplier, product and quantity; leave every optional input blank/default. Verify the saved receipt and stock increment.
validationScope: Mandatory-field and optional-field acceptance checks require a reachable standalone GRN form; do not claim those checks passed if that form is unavailable.
